author: Its_Vexus
body:
Name: Its_Vexus
Banned: Ban Evasion
Why? I dont even know why. Apparently because my friend copies the exact way I put my name and he has troubles playing on this server and I ask for help because he has appealed (His words not mine) a ton of times. I go in the server and ask the mod for help about it. The first mod throws me off just giving me to the website. Then the second mod ,SnowSX3, actually tries to help me and my friend. He gives good info and I relay the info back to my friend over skype and when my friend still has troubles, he goes and talks to other mods for help. The only way I can show that that isnt my alt account would be the fact is we used to play back in the day for hours together. I still talk to him and we play on other servers to this day. I even know him irl and I dont understand why I get put in the group that his account is my alt just because hes a retard who copies the way I have my name. Maybe Ill just change my name again to not get put in the same group as him as his "alt".
